description: Dimensional stylized collectible woman bust with swept long charcoal hair, image-right inner silver streak, black rounded square glasses and closed subtle smirk.

controls.AvatarRoot: Whole bust transform; breathe or rotate.
controls.HeadPivot: Head-local transform, origin at world [0, 2.12, 0]; hair, face and spectacles rotate together.
controls.Sweater: PBR material shared by torso, sleeves and collar; recolorable black or pearl grey.

rigType: Transform hierarchy; no skeleton, skinning or eyelid blink rig.
limitations: Procedural first blockout; likeness and premium visual quality require rendered review and user approval.
Hair is swept volumetric geometry with tapered tips, not simulated strands.
No hand meshes, full body, facial blendshapes, textures or pre-baked animations.
